card.title: I-16 ISHAK
card.flavorText: The I-16 Ishak, officially named Polikarpov I-16, was a Soviet fighter aircraft that was first introduced in the mid-1930s and was the world's first low-wing cantilever monoplane fighter with retractable landing gear. It first saw combat in 1936 in the Spanish civil war, and although it was outclassed by many modern fighters at the start of WWII, the I-16 fighter was used by the Soviets until the end of the war. The pilots nicknamed it "Ishak" (meaning donkey or burro in Russian) because it was similar to the Russian pronunciation of "I-16".
